summary: Frontend-only verification of Evidence Locker Sprint B5 (client-side AES-256 encryption at rest + new in-app video preview) on https://bharti-justice.preview.emergentagent.com (mobile viewport 375x667, logged in as voicetest2026@example.com). The previous CRITICAL SecureStore-on-web crash (iteration_25) is CONFIRMED FIXED — PinGate now renders/works correctly on web. All 10 requested scenarios were executed end-to-end in a single continuous browser session per flow and PASSED with zero console errors matching the forbidden patterns (aes-js, expo-video, Blob, evidenceCrypto, evidenceStore, VideoView, useVideoPlayer).

ui_bugs.issue: Minor/testability-only: testID="evidence-video-preview" passed to VideoView is NOT forwarded to the underlying native <video> DOM element on web (confirmed via document.querySelectorAll('video') — 1 real <video> tag exists with correct blob: src, controls, and it plays fine — but [data-testid="evidence-video-preview"] query returns null). Functionally harmless (feature works), but blocks automated testID-based selectors for this one element on web.

action_items: No blocking action required — feature is working correctly end-to-end.

Optional/low priority: forward testID to the inner web <video> element in InlineVideoPreview (e.g. via VideoView's nativeID or a wrapping View with testID) for more reliable automated testing on web; current behavior already works for real users.

Not independently verified in this run: legacy-plaintext (no `iv`) backward-compat items, since no pre-existing seeded evidence item could be found/injected in this environment. Code review of evidenceStore.ts/.web.ts confirms correct `if (!item.iv) return item.uri` / `if (!wasDecrypted) return` guards in getDecryptedTempUri and releaseDecryptedTempUri, which should handle this correctly by inspection, but was not runtime-exercised.
critical_code_review_comments: evidenceLock.ts / evidenceCrypto.ts now correctly branch on Platform.OS==='web' and use AsyncStorage as a fallback instead of unconditionally calling SecureStore — this resolves the prior critical red-screen crash.
Decrypt-on-demand pattern (getDecryptedTempUri/releaseDecryptedTempUri) with ref-tracked cleanup on unmount/delete/stop is well structured and leak-conscious.
InlineVideoPreview is correctly isolated per-item via remount (uri key), keeping useVideoPlayer's lifecycle scoped to one item at a time as intended.

Notice copy correctly updated in both locations (top: 'encrypted on this device and protected by your PIN'; bottom: 'encrypted on this device (AES-256)') — verified via text_content, exact match to spec.

success_rate.backend: NA (frontend-only request, zero backend involvement confirmed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 10 requested scenarios passed: PIN gate (create/confirm/wrong-rejected/correct-unlock) ✅, audio record->save->play->stop ✅, photo capture->decrypt->thumbnail render ✅, video capture->preview with loading spinner->native controls autoplay->close ✅, share (web correctly shows 'Sharing is not available on this device') ✅, delete with confirm/keep ✅ no crash, navigate-away-and-back (re-locks with PIN gate, then unlocks and persists items) ✅, notice text copy ✅, zero forbidden console errors ✅, mixed item types (audio+photo+video) rendered/behaved independently ✅ (though the specific audio-still-playing-during-video-preview check was inconclusive — the short ~2s test clip likely finished playback naturally via onFinish before the check, not necessarily a bug).

seed_data_creation: Created temporary local test assets only (not persisted to any DB): /tmp/test_video.mp4 (tiny synthetic mp4 via opencv-python for video-capture file-picker fallback testing). No backend/DB seed data created — feature is 100% local-device (AsyncStorage/IndexedDB), no Mongo involvement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used credential voicetest2026@example.com / TestPass123! (login flow requires consent-age-adult -> consent-terms-checkbox -> consent-data-checkbox -> consent-continue-button -> login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button each time, since every browser_automation call spins up a fresh browser profile with no persisted storage — all steps for a given flow must be done within ONE script call). Evidence Locker route: /women/evidence-locker. Web camera/video capture uses a native file-chooser dialog (page.expect_file_chooser) rather than ImagePicker's visual camera UI, since there's no real camera in this environment — that's expected and not a bug. 'Continue as Guest' flow redirected back to consent/login repeatedly when navigating directly to a deep link URL in this session — did not pursue further since logged-in flow covers 'device'-scoped encryption identically (scope key is independent of auth, only used as a storage namespace prefix).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found in this iteration. Prior iteration's SecureStore-on-web crash (evidenceLock.ts calling SecureStore.getItemAsync unconditionally) has been fixed with Platform.OS==='web' branching to AsyncStorage, matching the same pattern now also used in evidenceCrypto.ts's getOrCreateKey.
